chunks: He said: Abul Hasan 'Ali ibn Bilal al-Mahlabi narrated to us from Abu Ahmad al-'Abbas ibn al-Fadhl ibn Ja'far al-Azadi al-Makki, in Egypt, who narrated from 'Ali ibn Sa'id ibn Bashir al-Razi, who narrated from 'Ali ibn 'Abd al-Wahid, from Muhammad ibn Aban, who narrated from Muhammad ibn Tamam ibn Sabiq, who narrated from 'Amir ibn Sayyar, from Abu al-Sabbah, from Abu Tamam, from Ka'b al-Khayr, who said:

Abdullah ibn Salam came to the Messenger of Allah, may Allah's blessings be upon him and his family, before he had embraced Islam, and said: 'O Messenger of Allah, what appellation does 'Ali have among you?' The Prophet, peace be upon him and his progeny, said: ''Ali is al-Siddiq al-Akbar among us.'

Then Abdullah said: 'I bear witness that there is no god but Allah, and that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah. Indeed, we find in the Torah: Muhammad is the Prophet of Mercy, and 'Ali is the upholder of the Proof.'

key_terms.التَّوْرَاةِ: Torah: The Jewish scripture, referenced here as containing prophecies about Prophet Muhammad and Imam 'Ali
key_terms.الصِّدِّيقُ الْأَكْبَرُ: Al-Siddiq al-Akbar: 'The Greatest Truthful One' — a title given to Imam 'Ali (AS) by the Prophet, signifying his supreme truthfulness and faithfulness
key_terms.مُقِيمُ الْحُجَّةِ: Muqim al-Hujjah: 'The upholder of the Proof' — a title indicating 'Ali's role in establishing divine evidence and authority

ai.seo_question: What title did the Prophet Muhammad give to Imam Ali according to the hadith about Abdullah ibn Salam?
ai.summary: This hadith recounts the story of Abdullah ibn Salam, a learned Jewish scholar, coming to the Prophet Muhammad before his own conversion to Islam to ask about 'Ali's title. The Prophet described 'Ali as 'al-Siddiq al-Akbar' (the Greatest Truthful One), upon which Abdullah declared the shahadah and confirmed that this matched what was written in the Torah about Muhammad and 'Ali.

en.mulla-asgharali-m-m-jaffer: 6. He said: Abul Hasan ‘Ali ibn Bilal al-Mahlabi reported to me from Abu Ahmad al-Abbas ibn al-Fadhl ibn Ja’far al-Azadi al-Makki, in Egypt, who reported from ‘Ali ibn Saeed Ibn Basheer al-Razi, who reported from ‘Ali ibn Abdul Wahid, from Muhammad ibn Aban, who reported from Muhammad ibn Tamam ibn Sabiq, who reported from Amir ibn Sayyar, from Abu al-Sabah, from Abu Tamam, from Ka’b al-Habr, who said:

Abdullah ibn Salaam came to the Prophet before he had embraced Islam, and said: "O Messenger of Allah! What appellation does ‘Ali have among you?" The Prophet, peace be upon him and his progeny, said: "‘Ali is al-Siddiq al-Akbar among us."
Abdullah said: "I testify that there is no god but Allah and that Muhammad is His Prophet. Surely, we have read in Torah: Muhammad is the Prophet of Mercy and ‘Ali is the upholder of Proof."
